# Jimmy Essex
Jimmy Essex (born 1984 or 1985) is a British actor, dancer and musician. He first came to public attention as a singer on the ninth series of The X Factor in 2012, where he performed as part of a three-member band. Essex later gained prominence for his role as Adam Donovan in the Channel 4 soap opera Hollyoaks, appearing from 2016 to 2018 as a regular cast member. He has since taken on other acting projects in film and theatre, including a lead role in the 2020 stage play GHBoy.
## Early career and The X Factor
Essex was born in the mid-1980s and is from Harrow in Greater London. He trained in performing arts and initially worked in music and dance. In 2012, he participated in the UK singing competition The X Factor as part of a mixed-gender band called MITSOTU (an acronym for "Music Is The Soul Of The Universe"). The trio—comprising Essex and his bandmates James Collins and Holly Cooper—auditioned in front of an audience of 6,000 and received four “yes” votes from the judging panel, advancing past the first round. All three members had prior experience as backing dancers for pop artists, with Essex having performed alongside American singer Janet Jackson during her tour. The group ultimately did not progress to the live finals of The X Factor, being eliminated during the competition’s later stages. After their stint on the show, MITSOTU continued to perform at various venues, including a set at the Kensington Roof Gardens in London, before eventually disbanding.
Outside of music, Essex pursued opportunities in acting and modeling. In 2014, he appeared as a dancer in the short film Mr Bowler Presents – Hideaway. He also worked as a commercial performer, such as featuring in a Coca-Cola advertisement filmed in Madrid in 2016. These early forays in entertainment helped Essex transition his career focus from music to acting on television.
## Hollyoaks (2016–2018)
In March 2016, it was announced that Essex had been cast in the Channel 4 soap opera Hollyoaks, joining the established series as part of a new family introduced on-screen. He portrayed Adam Donovan, one of three half-brothers added to the show’s cast as the siblings of existing character Grace Black. Essex made his first appearance as Adam in April 2016. His character Adam was a former hairdresser with a moral streak, often acting as the more level-headed brother compared to his troublemaking siblings. Over his tenure in Hollyoaks, Adam Donovan was featured in several prominent storylines, including a romantic love triangle plot and involvement in the show’s criminal underworld.
Essex remained with Hollyoaks for two and a half years, during which time his character’s narrative took a darker turn. In 2018, the character Adam became entangled in a revenge and gang conflict storyline that culminated in a dramatic exit. In the episode broadcast on 23 May 2018, Adam Donovan is shot and killed by his own father, Glenn Donovan, in a surprise twist that marked the end of Essex’s run on the show. The shocking death of Adam—who had gradually shifted from “good guy” to morally compromised before his demise—was noted for its impact on viewers and the soap’s plot. After the episode aired, Essex recorded a goodbye message for fans and colleagues, in which he expressed gratitude to the Hollyoaks team and said he was happy with his character’s dramatic send-off. His performance and the exit storyline were well received, and Adam Donovan’s death was longlisted for the Inside Soap Awards 2018 in the category of “Best Exit.”
## Stage and other work
Following his departure from Hollyoaks, Essex expanded his acting repertoire with roles in independent films and stage productions. He had a supporting role as Peter in the British horror film A Dark Path, released in 2020. The same year, Essex made his West End theatre debut in the play GHBoy, a drama written by Paul Harvard and staged at London’s Charing Cross Theatre in December 2020. In GHBoy, Essex starred as Robert Finch, a gay man navigating grief, substance abuse, and relationship struggles against the backdrop of London’s chemsex scene. The production and its subject matter offered Essex a new challenge as a stage actor. He noted that he was excited to tackle more diverse LGBTQ+ stories beyond the typical coming-out narrative, and he valued the “innocence and vulnerability” of his character Robert. Despite disruptions in the theatre industry due to the COVID-19 pandemic, GHBoy ran during its planned schedule in late 2020, and Essex’s performance received praise for showcasing his range outside of soap opera roles.
Continuing to work in both screen and stage, Essex also appeared in a 2019 LGBTQ+ travel mini-series called Trailblazers, created by Gay Times and Celebrity Cruises, where he featured as himself. In 2022, he had a small part in the Netflix fantasy series The Sandman. In 2025, Essex took on a role in the short independent film Daddy Issues, playing a character named Felix. This mix of projects across different media reflects Essex’s versatility as a performer. He has additionally remained connected to television by taking guest roles; notably, in November 2025 he made a one-episode appearance in the BBC soap EastEnders, portraying a character involved in a brief bar altercation storyline.
## Personal life
Jimmy Essex is openly gay. He has been in a long-term relationship with musician Charles Simmons since 2013. In January 2019, Essex announced his engagement to Charles during a vacation in Sri Lanka, after Charles proposed with a diamond ring on the trip. The engagement news was met with public congratulations from Essex’s friends and former Hollyoaks co-stars on social media. The couple later married in 2020; Essex referred to Charles as his husband in interviews by the end of that year. In a 2020 discussion, Essex described Charles as his “best friend” and spoke about spending the COVID-19 lockdown period together. The pair also appeared together in the aforementioned Trailblazers travel series, where they shared their enthusiasm for food and travel as a couple. Essex and his husband reside in London.
Outside of his acting career, Essex stays active on social media and has engaged in charity events. For example, during his Hollyoaks tenure he participated in a sponsored “sleep-out” event for the youth homelessness charity Centrepoint, alongside some of his castmates, to raise awareness and funds for the cause. He has also spoken in interviews about his interests in fantasy fiction and his admiration for actors like James McAvoy. In his personal time, Essex enjoys fitness and often shares updates about his projects and daily life with fans on his Instagram account, where he has over 100,000 followers.

AN X FACTOR contestant, from Petts Wood, believes that her “urban pop” band can go all the way in the talent competition.

Holly Cooper, 23, of Woodhurst Avenue, is a part of MITSOTU - which stands for Music Is The Soul Of The Universe - who will find out if they have made the live shows this Saturday (29).

If the trio including James Collins, 22, and Jimmy Essex, 23, both from Harrow, make the final stage of the competition, Miss Cooper says, it will come as no surprise to them.

The part-time hospital worker said: “We do think that we could go all the way because there has never been anyone like us before.

“We are not really like any other band but we love Rihanna and No Doubt.”

MISTOTU did their first audition back in June in front of a 6,000 strong audience.

However, despite the daunting crowd they put on a brilliant performance to score four “yes” votes securing their path to the next stage.

Miss Cooper says the toughest stage but, also, the most enjoyable was the boot camp in Liverpool.

She said: “More than 200 performers were sent home after only couple of hours without even singing.

“It was harsh but that is reality TV.

“Boot camp was the hardest thing we have ever done.”

The reason for MISTOTU’s progress through the competition, according to Miss Cooper, is the experience they have had of performing live.

All three members have all performed with world famous pop stars as backing dancers: Miss Cooper with The Wanted, Mr Collins has danced with The Saturdays and Mr Essex has performed alongside Janet Jackson.

However, despite their experience the group had their doubts about Louis Walsh, who is mentoring the group.

Miss Copper added: “At first because we are an urban pop group we thought 'oh, we got Louis' but he is really cool.”

The group, who each have the tattoo MITSOTU on their left arm, toured schools across the borough last year to play for youngsters.

But if they are put through on Saturday night’s X Factor show then the band can maybe dream of playing across the world once again as MITSOTU.

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

| Jimmy Essex
 |
| --- |
| Occupations | Actor  
Musician  
Dancer |
| Years active | 2011– |
| Television | _[The X Factor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_X_Factor_/(British_TV_series/) "The X Factor (British TV series)")_  
_[Hollyoaks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hollyoaks "Hollyoaks")_ |
| Spouse | Charles Simmons |

**Jimmy Essex** is a British actor, dancer and musician. Essex performed as part of a band in the [ninth series](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_X_Factor_/(British_TV_series/)_series_9 "The X Factor (British TV series) series 9") of _[The X Factor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_X_Factor_/(British_TV_series/) "The X Factor (British TV series)")_ in 2012, but the band did not get through to the live finals. Essex has also worked as a [backup dancer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Backup_dancer "Backup dancer"). From 2016 to 2018, Essex played the regular role of [Adam Donovan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adam_Donovan_/(Hollyoaks/) "Adam Donovan (Hollyoaks)") on the British [soap opera](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soap_opera "Soap opera") _[Hollyoaks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hollyoaks "Hollyoaks")_. Essex played the lead role in the 2020 play _GHBoy_ and has appeared in other acting projects.

Essex was born in 1984 or 1985.[\[1\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-1)[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-2)[\[3\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Hollyoaks_4-3) He is from [Harrow, London](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrow,_London "Harrow, London").[\[4\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-X_Factor_1-4) Essex is a singer and actor and has been in the [West End](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/West_End_theatre "West End theatre").[\[5\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-5) In 2014, Essex appeared in the video _Mr Bowler Presents - Hideaway_.[\[6\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Credits-6) He has also been a [backup dancer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Backup_dancer "Backup dancer") for [Janet Jackson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Janet_Jackson "Janet Jackson").[\[4\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-X_Factor_1-4) In 2012, Essex appeared in the [ninth series](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_X_Factor_/(British_TV_series/)_series_9 "The X Factor (British TV series) series 9") of the British television music competition _[The X Factor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_X_Factor_/(British_TV_series/) "The X Factor (British TV series)")_, performing as part of the band "MITSOTU" (which stands for "Music Is The Soul Of The Universe") with James Collins and Holly Cooper.[\[4\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-X_Factor_1-4)[\[7\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-X_Factor_2-7) The group, who had previously performed in various London schools in 2011, did their first audition for the show in June 2012 in front of an audience of 6000 people and went through to the next stage of the show after scoring four "yes" votes.[\[4\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-X_Factor_1-4) All three members had "MITSOTU" tattooed on their left arms.[\[4\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-X_Factor_1-4) The group was unsuccessful in getting to the talent show's live finals, losing out to rival group MK1.[\[7\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-X_Factor_2-7) However, the band continued performing gigs at other venues, such as [Kensington Roof Gardens](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kensington_Roof_Gardens "Kensington Roof Gardens").[\[7\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-X_Factor_2-7) Reflecting on the experience in 2017, Essex said, "It was such a fun time in my life and I did it with my two best friends, so I wouldn't have changed it. But I am glad that it ended where it did, because it's left the door open for other things and I think if it had gone any further, it probably would have stopped that from happening."[\[8\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Darcy-8) He added that he still likes to sing but could not imagine singing in public anymore.[\[8\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Darcy-8) Essex was also in the 2016 advertisements for [Coca-Cola](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coca-Cola "Coca-Cola"), which he filmed in [Madrid](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madrid "Madrid").[\[9\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-9)

[![Image 2](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/7a/Lisa_Maxwell_and_Dominic_Power_at_the_BAFTA%27s.jpg/250px-Lisa_Maxwell_and_Dominic_Power_at_the_BAFTA%27s.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Lisa_Maxwell_and_Dominic_Power_at_the_BAFTA%27s.jpg)

Essex enjoyed working with Lisa Maxwell (_pictured_) on _Hollyoaks_

In March 2016, it was announced that Essex joined the cast of the British soap opera _[Hollyoaks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hollyoaks "Hollyoaks")_ as [Adam Donovan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adam_Donovan_/(Hollyoaks/) "Adam Donovan (Hollyoaks)"), who was introduced with his younger brothers [Jesse](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jesse_Donovan "Jesse Donovan") ([Luke Jerdy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luke_Jerdy "Luke Jerdy")) and [Liam Donovan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liam_Donovan "Liam Donovan") ([Maxim Baldry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maxim_Baldry "Maxim Baldry")) as an extension of [Grace Black](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grace_Black "Grace Black")'s ([Tamara Wall](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tamara_Wall "Tamara Wall")) family.[\[10\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Hollyoaks_1-10)[\[11\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-11) Essex was thrilled to join the soap, saying, "_Hollyoaks_ is already starting to feel like home. Adam has some amazing storylines coming up and I can't wait to share them with the fans. The Donovan brothers are definitely going to cause a stir!"[\[10\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Hollyoaks_1-10) Essex, Baldry and Jerdy had auditioned together.[\[12\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-12) Essex' debut as Adam aired in April of that year.[\[3\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Hollyoaks_4-3)[\[10\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Hollyoaks_1-10) After his initial appearance in April 2016,[\[10\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Hollyoaks_1-10) Essex's return to the soap aired on 13 June of that year.[\[13\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-13) Essex revealed that he felt very nervous when he first started on the soap, and Jerdy said that Essex was so nervous saying his lines during his first scenes that he was shaking, although he "got away with it" because it was cold.[\[14\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Hollyoaks_3-14)[\[3\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Hollyoaks_4-3) Essex later said that he became more comfortable working on the soap.[\[3\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Hollyoaks_4-3) Jerdy and Wall have joked that Essex was the "worst" for giggling on set and would sometimes have to walk off set because of it.[\[15\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-15)[\[16\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-16) Essex felt like that the Donovan brothers had been received positively by _Hollyoaks_ viewers.[\[8\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Darcy-8) The actor had been a fan of _Hollyoaks_ and felt nervous meeting some of the cast as he knew them from watching the show.[\[17\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Interview_2-17) Essex also enjoyed working with [Lisa Maxwell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lisa_Maxwell_/(actress/) "Lisa Maxwell (actress)"), who plays the brothers' mother [Tracey Donovan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tracey_Donovan "Tracey Donovan"), and found it "bizarre" to work with her initially as he used to watch her on television, and Essex ended up getting to know her and went to her house.[\[8\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Darcy-8)[\[18\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Interview-18) As his character was a [hairdresser](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hairdresser "Hairdresser"), Essex was given some lessons in the profession to help him with the portrayal.[\[18\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Interview-18)

> "I was so nervous, that I spent about a week learning \[my lines\] through and through. It was awful. I forgot how to walk. I was walking same arms and legs because I was that nervous. It was horrible".

–Essex reflecting on his initial _Hollyoaks_ scenes (2018)[\[3\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Hollyoaks_4-3)

One of Adam's storyline saw a love triangle between Adam, [Maxine Minniver](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maxine_Minniver "Maxine Minniver") ([Nikki Sanderson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nikki_Sanderson "Nikki Sanderson")) and [Darcy Wilde](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Darcy_Wilde "Darcy Wilde") ([Aisling Jarrett-Gavin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aisling_Jarrett-Gavin "Aisling Jarrett-Gavin")).[\[19\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-19)[\[8\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Darcy-8) Essex wanted Maxine and Adam to get married as he described himself a "sucker for a wedding".[\[20\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-20) Essex enjoyed working with Jarrett-Gavin and revealed that the pair would spend time together out outside of work, adding that the pair got along "like a house on fire".[\[8\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Darcy-8) Essex and Jarrett-Gavin had also gone to the same school.[\[21\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-21) In 2018, Adam was involved in a storyline where his behaviour got darker and was involved in a mystery storyline where Adam was seen being told to shoot someone in a flash forward episode; Essex enjoyed portraying the villainous side to the character, but believed that Adam was doing bad things for the "right reasons in his mind".[\[22\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-22)[\[23\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-23)[\[24\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-24) The plot eventually led to Adam being fatally shot by his father [Glenn Donovan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glenn_Donovan "Glenn Donovan") (Bob Cryer) in the episode originally airing on 23 May 2018, which shocked and upset _Hollyoaks_ viewers.[\[25\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-25)[\[26\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Hollyoaks_2-26)[\[27\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-27) Reflecting on his departure in a video on _Hollyoaks'_ [YouTube](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YouTube "YouTube") channel, Essex thanked the _Hollyoaks_ team and viewers for supporting him.[\[14\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Hollyoaks_3-14)[\[26\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Hollyoaks_2-26) Essex brought in doughnuts on his last day working on the soap.[\[14\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Hollyoaks_3-14) He also described his _Hollyoaks_ experience as "the best two and a half years ever".[\[14\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Hollyoaks_3-14) Essex also said that he was very happy with his exit storyline, saying, "I think it's really, really shocking. I like the build-up to it - the good guy gone bad and then it turns back round, but then it's too late".[\[3\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Hollyoaks_4-3) He also liked how it made Glenn's character "so evil".[\[3\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Hollyoaks_4-3)[\[28\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-28) Adam's death was longlisted for "Best Exit" at the [2018 _Inside Soap_ Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inside_Soap_Awards#2018 "Inside Soap Awards").[\[29\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-29)[\[30\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-30) Sanderson revealed in 2019 that she still kept in touch with Essex and enjoyed working with him.[\[31\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-31)

Essex portrayed Peter in the 2020 film _A Dark Path_.[\[6\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Credits-6)[\[32\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-32) Essex was then part of the cast of the play _GHBoy_, which was due to be performed in December 2020 at [Charing Cross Theatre](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charing_Cross_Theatre "Charing Cross Theatre").[\[33\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-GHBoy-33)[\[34\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Chemsex-34) The play explored [chemsex](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chemsex "Chemsex") within the LGBTQ+ male community.[\[34\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Chemsex-34) Essex portrayed Robert Finch, a character who is grieving the death of his father whilst dealing with substance abuse and infidelity.[\[34\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Chemsex-34)[\[33\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-GHBoy-33) Essex said that the character's "innocence" and "vulnerability" drew him into the role, and said that he related to the character's "journey", adding, "I've made choices based on things that I've wanted, and not maybe looked at who that may be hurting".[\[34\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Chemsex-34) Essex was happy to have the "challenge" of theatre, and said that he wanted to tell [LGBTQ](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LGBTQ "LGBTQ") stories beyond the "coming out thing".[\[34\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Chemsex-34) Essex also expressed frustration at the lack of support given by the government towards the theatre industry during the [COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/COVID-19_pandemic_in_the_United_Kingdom "COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom"), saying, "I think \[the arts have\] been quite neglected, it's really been pushed aside and treated as a second-class job".[\[34\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Chemsex-34) In 2025, Essex was part of the short film _Daddy Issues_.[\[35\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Daddy_Issues-35)

Essex had a dog named Stevie as of 2017.[\[18\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-Interview-18)[\[36\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Essex#cite_note-36) Whilst working on _Hollyoaks_, Essex would often visit his colleagues [Jessica Ellis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jessica_Ellis "Jessica Ellis") ([Tegan Lomax](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tegan_Lomax "Tegan Lomax")) and [Andrew Hayden-Smith](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andrew_Hayden-Smith "Andrew Hayden-Smith") ([DS Gavin Armstrong](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DS_Gavin_Armstrong "DS Gavin **Former Hollyoaks star Jimmy Essex has announced his engagement to musician boyfriend Charles in a sweet Instagram post.**

The actor – who played hairdresser Adam Donovan on the hit Channel 4 soap before being killed off last year – shared the snap of the happy couple kissing on holiday in Sri Lanka.

The picture also showed Jimmy holding a ring box open revealing his unique engagement ring.

He captioned it with the words: ‘So ... this happened’, alongside a diamond ring emoji.

> [](https://www.instagram.com/p/Bs5vzYalYOM/)
> 
> A photo posted by on

The post attracted more than 19,000 likes and fans were quick to offer the pair their congratulations.

One wrote: ‘@jimmy\_essex ahhhh I’m so happy for you ♥ you honestly deserve nothing but the best x’

While another added: ‘Huge congratulations to you both. So bloody happy for you xxx’

>

Hollyoaks co-star Tamara Wall, who plays Grace Black, gushed: 'Best thing ever!!!!!!!!!!’

Hollyoaks actress Chelsee Healy, who plays Goldie McQueen, added: ‘Ahhhhh congrats’

While Blue singer and former Hollyoaks star Duncan James added: ‘Awwwwwww massive congrats guys xxx’

X Factor star Marcus Collins also chimed in with the words: ‘CONGRATULATIONS YOU TWO’

Charles, who's surname has not been reported, posted an identical snap of the couple on his Instagram account, this time including two more images of a smiling Jimmy accepting his proposal.

One excited fan wrote: ‘Congrats guys! hope you have a wonderful life together!’

While another added: ‘OMG THIS HAS MADE MY DAY’

> [](https://www.instagram.com/p/BXm6_VIB7m6/)
> 
> A photo posted by on

He wrote: ‘6 years and counting... He said yes.’

34-year-old Jimmy has been dating Charles since 2013 and the couple has chronicled every stage of their love story via their Instagram accounts.

In 2017 Jimmy marked the couple's four-year anniversary by sharing a picture captioned with the words: 'Thank you for putting up with me, 4 years!! You must be mental! I love you.@charlesmusic\_'

A huge congratulations to Jimmy and Charles, and we’re on a countdown until the Big Day!
